scope: Source and resource feasibility of per960 I4 projection consumers; no quantizer, host/model activation, standalone ELF or Arena execution
references: p512-f4-partialscale-micro/src/ops_ffn_f4_projection.rs: group scaling before F32 shard sum
src/ops_ffn_projection_clusters.rs: current joined UP/GATE ownership and output layout
input_reference: Signed I4 codes in [-7,7], canonical P512H960/P512L960 blocked order. Input row scales are from the separately specified activation quantizer.
weight_reference: Per960 CPU-quantized BF16(provided F4*provided E4) before the original separate global scale. Group scales contain source amplitude; no extra native-E4 row_dequant factor.
up_gate: Projection-owned clusters preserve current joined weights/output. Four P128 chunks cover all512 tokens per projection; K64 I4 packets, 61440-byte TRF.
down: Token-owned clusters, two P128 chunks each, original blocked output and separate BF16/global boundary.
local_arithmetic: I32 dot over960 -> exact numeric F32 conversion -> group scale -> original 4/16-shard F32 sum -> activation row scale -> BF16. Separate vector Mul0 and Mul1 aim to avoid an intermediate F32 DM tensor; lowering is unverified.
excluded_and_not_claimed: integer packing and public raw binding
failure_policy: Preserve failed lowering/resource evidence; only concrete correctness/lowering repairs, no gate relaxation or parameter sweep
next_gates: Independent source review, intended-code dot/layout/device oracle, then complete quantize/pack/UPGATE/GeGLU/hiddenquant/pack/DOWN against current production graph with all movement counted
build: Original dependencies and locked Cargo; root-owned r64-server target only; fresh package and new empty kernel output directories
